answer: In apprenticeship registries, each new agent must anchor its identity to a sponsor whose signed delta of prior trainee attestations forms a verifiable lineage chain. A candidate whose sponsor lineage traces back through a single vine of unverified referrals is flagged, while any raven node broadcasting unsolicited credentials triggers cross-registry quorum review. Adversaries forging identities face an immediate O(Delta * S) capital forfeiture.
